Market today: Tech is getting hammered, especially chips, as earnings season disappoints in key areas. The real driver is the market's reaction to earnings, which is hitting your concentrated tech/chip book hard.

Your holdings: SMCI (-28.46%), SOXL (-67.47%), SPAL (-42.9%), MUU (-39.88%), and PLTU (-16.5%) are all in deep water and flagged for attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: The S&P 500's technical levels (headline 8) and how AMD and Apple's earnings (headlines 1, 2, 5) impact sentiment in related names.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your significant losses in the leveraged ETFs and chip names.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL further if they break key support levels, given their leveraged nature and deep losses.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
